rows.description: Supply, Installation and Testing of controller for BACNet integration above VAV Boxes with BMS. Controller should be suitable to be integrated with minimum 55Nos. of VAV Boxes. Integrator shall be capable of soft integration with BMS system.

Supply, laying, affecting connections and Testing of all necessary copper control wiring/ daisy chain cabling etc. as required for proper functioning & integration of VAVs with above controller. All cabling to be laid in MS conduits. Quoted price shall be inclusive of all necessary arrangement to make system complete & functional.

Supply and Installation of BACnet control for integrating all the VAVs which includes Supply and Installation of VAV router to integrate VAVs on BMS system for monitoring and Controlling. The router shall be provided in MS powder coated enclosure with all necessary accessories such as indication lamps, control wiring , control transformer, terminals , cables, cable trays,etc.necessary cabling and terminal provision. The set shall be inclusive of required number of routers to connect all the VAV units in the project.(Router capacity to be consider 30-35 VAV)
Unification adaptor for connecting between central remote controller and BMS Computer on BACnet protocol.

Supply,installation,testing & comissioning of all necessary Network controller or Router, Interface to connect the proposed floor BACNET MS/TP VAV with the main BMS system via Native BACnet / IP. Network controller or Router - Shall automatic rout BACnet messages between BACnet IP, BACnet Ethernet, BACnet PTP, and BACnet MS/TP ports and sub-lan networks. It shall conformance to ANSI/ASHRAE standard 135-2008 for designated “router” functions. The controller shall support foreign device registration with BACnet Broadcast Management Devices (BBMD). Total no. of network controller shall be based on manufacturer requirement. 1 network controller / router panel shall not exceed integrating / connecting 30 VAV boxes. The Network controller or Router shall be housed in a suitable metal enclosure with proper power protection. Integrator to have necessary convertors for taking into BOS system .necessary software. Integration of vav router to BMS via cat 6 cable to be part of scope. Integrator to be with RS485 port
SITC OF DIGITAL Thermostat connect to shared vav (including any additional accessories if required)

The integrator shall also include daisy control wiring connecting VAV Boxes. price shall be inclusive of necessary conduting, copper control cabling from the integrator to the VAVs as per "Approved Shop Drawings".

All VAVs to be interlinked with LAN connectivity, with one centralized 7" display provided to monitor and control all VAV status, temperature readings, and opening percentage. The system shall communicate over BACnet/IP. Scope includes complete setup of the display interface, necessary network switches/routers, and integration of all VAVs onto a common Interface with future compatibility to BMS. Scope also includes any required cabling and network hardware for full functionality. The quoted cost includes complete integration of all VAVs into the Interface. Master controller to be BMS compactible as future they can integrate if needed based on the requirement.

Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of Air Flow Monitoring Station (AFMS) suitable for measuring and monitoring airflow in supply/return/ exhaust air ducts as specified. The AFMS shall comprise an aerodynamically designed multi-port averaging airflow sensor (pitot array or equivalent), differential pressure transmitter, and necessary signal conditioning to ensure accurate airflow measurement over a broad range of velocities. The sensor shall be constructed of corrosion-resistant aluminum/stainless steel and designed to provide amplified differential pressure output for enhanced accuracy. The differential pressure transmitter shall be factory-calibrated, capable of providing 0–10V/4–20mA output for integration with the Building Management System (BMS). The AFMS assembly shall include mounting hardware, airflow tap points, isolation valves (where required), and airtight duct penetration seals. Installation shall ensure correct placement per manufacturer-recommended straight duct lengths upstream and downstream for reliable measurement. The system shall be calibrated, tested, and commissioned on-site, with all wiring, termination, labeling, and integration with BMS completed as per project specifications and OEM guidelines. Complete in all respects.
